**q25.** Engine: Google CEL (`github.com/google/cel-go`) wrapped by the in-repo `internal/filter` package — `internal/filter/engine.go:24-25` (env from `internal/filter/schema.go`), with `filter.DefaultEngine()` at `internal/filter/engine.go:111`. Mechanism: the CEL expression is compiled to an AST, lowered into a dialect-neutral condition IR (`internal/filter/parser.go`, `internal/filter/ir.go`), then rendered to a SQL fragment + args by `internal/filter/render.go` for the requested dialect (`DialectSQLite`/`DialectMySQL`/`DialectPostgres`, `internal/filter/schema.go:14-16`), which each driver appends to its WHERE clause via `filter.AppendConditions` (`store/db/sqlite/memo.go:61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:69`).

**q26.** `memo`, `memo_relation`, `attachment`, `memo_share`.
- `memo_relation` + `attachment` deleted explicitly in `Store.DeleteMemo` (`store/memo.go:140-158`); `memo` row at `store/memo.go:157`.
- `memo_share` removed by DB-level `ON DELETE CASCADE` (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:109`, `postgres/LATEST.sql:108`, `mysql/LATEST.sql:108`).
- Comment memos (and their relations/attachments) are also deleted, from the API handler `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:567-577` — same four tables.
- Note: `reaction` rows are **not** deleted (only read for the webhook payload, `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:545`).

**q27.** Mechanism: the Vite build output is embedded into the Go binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served by Echo's static middleware plus an SPA-fallback middleware. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:22-23` (embed), `:41-60` (`Serve`: `middleware.StaticWithConfig` + `spaFallbackMiddleware` + `registerRoutes`), invoked from `server/server.go:71`.

**q28.**
```
s3presign runner — server/server.go:162-168: RunOnce at startup, then a 12h time.Ticker
                   (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:26-40)
webhook async dispatch workers — 4 goroutines consuming a 128-slot queue, started in
                   package init() (internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-55); triggered per webhook.PostAsync call
```
Unused infrastructure: `internal/scheduler` — a full cron-expression scheduler (`internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `parser.go`, `job.go`, `doc.go`) that is imported only by its own tests (`internal/scheduler/integration_test.go`, `example_test.go`); nothing in the server uses it. Also `server/runner/memopayload.Runner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:19,27`) is never instantiated — only the package's `RebuildMemoPayload` helper is used (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:18`).

```
interceptor path — web/src/connect.ts:148 (authInterceptor; installed on the transport at :175-180)
token kinds — short-lived JWT access token (sent as "Authorization: Bearer ...", stored/refreshed via
              web/src/auth-state.ts, cross-tab sync via BroadcastChannel) + an httpOnly refresh-token
              cookie used by AuthService.RefreshToken (web/src/connect.ts:66-80, credentials:"include");
              the backend additionally accepts Personal Access Tokens on the same Bearer header
backend package — server/auth (server/auth/authenticator.go: AuthenticateByAccessTokenV2 :41,
              AuthenticateByRefreshToken :61, AuthenticateByPAT :102; token parsing in server/auth/token.go),
              driven by the Connect interceptor NewAuthInterceptor / gateway middleware in
              server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go and server/router/api/v1/v1.go:68-93
```

**q30.**
```
memo.created:         APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15 (called memo_service.go:157)
memo.updated:         APIV1Service.DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook — memo_service_webhooks.go:20 (called memo_update_helpers.go:67)
memo.deleted:         APIV1Service.DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook — memo_service_webhooks.go:25 (called memo_service.go:562)
memo.comment.created: APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook — memo_service_webhooks.go:30 (called memo_service_comments.go:119)
```
The first three converge on `APIV1Service.dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:47`); all four then converge on `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184` / `:120`.
